messages:
maya: kicking off Kestrel region commissioning — short smoke + SLO gate run before handoff. target pool = 8xA100, private control plane, 2 public egress subnets. post quick pass results here.
liam: copying. I'll verify node registration, kube health, and runtime pods.
liam: ran node inventory: ```
kubectl get nodes -l region=kestrel -o wide
NAME           STATUS   ROLES    AGE
kestrel-n1     Ready    gpu      35m
kestrel-n2     Ready    gpu      34m
kestrel-n3     Ready    gpu      33m
kestrel-n4     Ready    gpu      32m
kestrel-n5     Ready    gpu      31m
kestrel-n6     Ready    gpu      30m
kestrel-n7     Ready    gpu      29m
kestrel-n8     Ready    gpu      28m
``` 
liam: node count = 8 Ready ✅, kube-system pods 0 CrashLoop. `kubectl get pods -n kube-system` shows CNI, kube-proxy, coredns healthy.
samir: running intra-cluster network perf (iperf3) between GPU subnets, will post numbers.
samir: iperf3 results (client->server, tcp, 30s): 9.1 Gbits/s avg, jitter < 1ms. no packet loss on repeated runs.
netty: BGP sessions established to both IX peers, MTU set to 9000. saw one transient flap at t-18m (carrier), healed. No route blackholes.
jules: storage sanity: PVs provisioned for model-cache and checkpoints. local NVMe mounts present on each GPU node, used space < 20%.
ops-bot: deploy job `kestrel-bootstrap` finished — status: success, failedPods=0, rollout=complete :white_check_mark:
maya: SLO quick-gate: run 64-token generation, concurrency 10, p95 latency <= 120ms target for this model profile. use bench tool: `bench/genbench --model rdx-small --tokens 64 --concurrency 10`
liam: bench results: p50 38ms, p95 87ms, p99 245ms. p99 above expected SLO. tagging for triage.
samir: investigated p99 tail — two nodes showing higher GPU temperature throttling spikes during bench. logs show repeated thermal throttling on kestrel-n3 and kestrel-n7.
jules: checking node-level telemetry: `journalctl -u nvidia-dkms` shows repeated driver reset on those hosts. NVLink firmware mismatch suspected.
maya: plan: cordon+drain the two nodes, reboot with firmware patch, re-run bench. roll to avoid cluster-wide impact.
liam: cordoned kestrel-n3,n7 and drained. reboot scheduled now.
ops-bot: action log: cordon kestrel-n3,kestrel-n7 — pods evicted -> rescheduled across remaining GPUs.
netty: ran cross-AZ failover test: simulated AZ outage by disabling routes to AZ-B; traffic drained to AZ-A and AZ-C within 12s, no unhealthy nodes in router pool.
ryan-fin: quick cost note: this region provisioned as Dedicated burstable — projected baseline monthly GPU hours ~ 5760h -> est monthly infra $11.8k (estimate excludes egress/managed services). flagged to finance.
maya: after node reboot, re-run bench and KV cache warmup: run 1k prefix warmups and subsequent latency sweep.
liam: post-reboot bench: p50 36ms, p95 82ms, p99 98ms — all within gate now. NVLink fw patch fixed tail.
samir: KV/prefix cache warmup: warmed 10k prefixes across caches, cache hit ratio 92% on first token, subsequent token cost drop ~ 35%.
jules: final acceptance checklist before handoff:
- nodes: 8 Ready ✅
- kube pods: system + runtime healthy ✅
- network: BGP/MTU ok, failover tested ✅
- storage: PVs healthy, disk space ok ✅
- bench: p95/p50 within SLO, p99 within guard ✅
- thermal/driver issues resolved ✅
- cache warmup & hit ratios acceptable ✅
- cost estimate captured and sent to finance ✅
- runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kestrel-commissioning (doc updated with rollback steps)
maya: handing to oncall for monitoring + SLA watch — @oncall-ai please take over for 24h watch and escalate if regressions.
oncall-ai: ACK. monitoring alert rules: gpu-temp > 85C, p95 latency > 120ms, packet-loss > 0.5% will trigger paging. I'll monitor dashboards and logs.
maya: thanks team. if no regressions in 24h we mark region as Green and close commissioning task.
liam: adding short note: follow-up action item — run cost vs perf analysis after 7 days with production-like traffic to decide on reserved commit level.
ryan-fin: noted. will pair with eng-finops to run that analysis.
maya: closing thread for now. ping if anything pops up. :rocket:
